description:
READ-ONLY: progress of the background pump job on `target_db` (running / finished / failed,
    the last log lines) and, from the report, an owner-readable summary with the VERDICT (OK only
    when every proof check passed - a check that did not run is not a pass). `section` returns one
    raw report section (e.g. 'compare', 'post', 'neutralize', 'smoke').
name: data_pump_status
